raw_text: Viral video claiming to show fresh military crackdown in Srinagar on June 15, 2024 is FALSE. BoomLive investigation reveals: (1) The video was first posted on July 12, 2016 on a now-deleted Facebook page. (2) Google Street View comparison of the location confirms Lal Chowk area architecture matches 2016 configuration before renovation. (3) The uniforms worn by security forces in the video are the pre-2018 pattern replaced under Army Order 15/2018. (4) No internet shutdown or Section 144 was imposed in Srinagar on June 15. Verdict: OLD VIDEO, FALSE CONTEXT.
clean_text: BoomLive fact check confirms video is from July 2016. Evidence includes original Facebook post date, Google Street View architecture comparison, pre-2018 uniform pattern, and no internet shutdown on June 15 2024. Verdict: old video with false context.
